body_lead: Bhubaneswar, Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Friday said artificial intelligence (AI) laboratories are being set up in nine Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) of the state. Addressing the closing ceremony of the Odisha Skill Competition 2025-26, Majhi said a total of 47 ITIs will be developed as centres of excellence. Noting that the process of large-scale industrialisation has begun in Odisha, the chief minister called upon students to get themselves skilled and secure employment in the state.
